run_sample_questions: run the script to sample and filter questions from a JSONL dataset file to an output file
run_stratified_sampling: run stratified sampling of database questions by type and fact count bins from an input JSONL file
run_question_filtering: run the question filtering pipeline that drops weak argmin argmax and simple bool questions from a dataset
run_size_binning: run the size binning logic to categorize questions by number of facts into discrete bins
run_complexity_analysis: run the script to analyze and print question type and complexity distribution statistics from a sampled dataset
